provider_query: Which organization does the CVE program identify as the source of CVE records used by NVD
answer:
The CVE Program identifies the **CVE List**—launched and operated through **The MITRE Corporation**—as the source that feeds the CVE records used by NVD.

- On its related-efforts page, the CVE Program states that CVE and NVD are separate programs, the CVE List was launched by The MITRE Corporation in 1999, and “The CVE List feeds NVD,” which then enriches those records.  
  [[1]](https://www.cve.org/about/relatedefforts)
- The same wording appears in the CVE Program FAQs: the CVE List (MITRE, 1999) feeds NVD (NIST, 2005), which builds on the information in CVE Records.  
  [[2]](https://www.cve.org/ResourcesSupport/FAQs)
- NVD’s own general FAQs state that the CVE Program is maintained by the MITRE Corporation (sponsored by DHS/CISA), the CVE List is the public catalog of vulnerabilities, and NVD is synchronized with the CVE List so updates appear in NVD.  
  [[3]](https://nvd.nist.gov/general/FAQ-Sections/General-FAQs)
- NVD’s CVE process page likewise says the CVE program is maintained by the MITRE Corporation and that CVEs published to the CVE List typically appear in NVD within about an hour for later enrichment.  
  [[4]](https://nvd.nist.gov/general/cve-process)
- NVD’s CVE FAQs describe NVD’s role as enriching each CVE only after it has been published to the CVE List (descriptions and reference links come from that list, not from NVD).  
  [[5]](https://nvd.nist.gov/general/FAQ-Sections/CVE-FAQs)
- NVD states that it processes the CVE List about hourly to ingest new publications, rejections, and modifications.  
  [[3]](https://nvd.nist.gov/general/FAQ-Sections/General-FAQs)
- The official CVE List in CVE JSON 5 format is published by the CVE Program (CVEProject/cvelistV5 on GitHub) as the catalog of CVE Records identified by or reported to the program.  
  [[6]](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5.git)
- Secondary summaries of the pipeline describe MITRE’s CVE Program as the authoritative source of the CVE record of existence, with NIST NVD importing that list and adding analysis (CVSS, CWE, CPE, and related metadata).  
  [[7]](https://inventivehq.com/blog/nvd-vs-mitre-cve-differences)
